prohibited_inputs: diagnostic-development episodes or outputs already inspected
question paraphrases, evidence masks, or reruns counted as new independent clusters

primary_comparison.proposed: P: frozen diagnosis + provenance + checked plan + realization + final verification/fallback
fairness: same robot-visible evidence and source/configuration excerpts
same executable diagnostic tools and tool descriptions
same model family, version, reasoning configuration, and sampling settings where applicable
same maximum model calls, tool calls, input tokens, wall-clock budget, and permitted external resources
condition identity, evaluator truth, checked plan, verifier/fallback state, and other methods' answers hidden
primary_comparison.selection_basis: Development evidence showed tool-enabled R was stronger than N and frequently matched P/T; no confirmatory outcome was used.

primary_outcome.name: supported_diagnostic_success
primary_outcome.definition: On a diagnosable question, the final answer identifies the independently required supported physical/execution mechanism and contains no material unsupported or contradicted assertion.
primary_outcome.semantic_origin: Luna-assessed under a separately frozen and held-out-qualified judge configuration
primary_outcome.reported_alongside: independently checkable diagnostic measurements and references

target_distribution.sampling: Each independent configuration is sampled prospectively from this fixed categorical mixture. No outcome-dependent reweighting or family oversampling is allowed.
target_distribution.surface_readiness_rule: No campaign using this distribution may start until both surface mechanism strata pass development admission. If they do not, register a new land-only protocol before collecting outcomes; do not silently reallocate their weight.

analysis.unit: one predeclared primary response per independent scenario cluster
analysis.confidence_method: fixed-mixture nonnegative betting e-process for bounded paired differences in [-1,1]
analysis.monitoring: anytime-valid over cluster arrivals under the declared conditional-mean assumptions
analysis.gate_correction: Bonferroni over the four required bounds within each campaign allocation
analysis.secondary_methods: T and N are descriptive/exploratory unless separately allocated alpha before collection

error_budget_ledger.rule: An allocation is consumed when its first confirmatory response is inspected. Failed, futile, unresolved, or abandoned campaigns do not refund alpha. New candidates require an unused allocation or a prospectively versioned program ledger.

stopping_rule.success: All four corrected bounds pass, the held-out Luna qualification remains valid, and all minimum sample and replication requirements apply.
stopping_rule.futility: At a scheduled review, stop for prospective method review when the nonbinding 95% anytime upper bound for primary improvement is at or below +0.15.
stopping_rule.maximum: At 400 clusters stop regardless of significance; report unresolved or negative results if success has not occurred.

judge_gate.required: A new Luna configuration must pass the frozen development and held-out qualification protocol before campaign scoring.
judge_gate.two_pass_rule: Two isolated passes; deterministic disagreement resolution only; otherwise unresolved.
judge_gate.systematic_bias_rule: Additional responses cannot repair a failed judge category. Restrict the endpoint or qualify a new judge prospectively.

replication.success_criterion: The replication allocation independently passes the same +0.15 primary threshold and all three guardrails under fresh configurations.
